llm.summary: The OpenClaw plugin needs review because it ignores approval settings and can let flagged memory-saving actions proceed.

dimensions.detail: Agent-config, MCP-config, transcript and .env access is disclosed for memory and auditing. Credential-theft and auto-approval allegations based on explicit prohibitions are unsupported. Bundled cloud senders require cloud enablement plus an API key and remove content previews; full memory sync is separately disclosed as opt-in.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: Setup and updates are disclosed. The hook can automatically execute unpinned `npx -y shieldcortex` when no local binary exists, and invokes `npx mcporter`. These introduce mutable package dependencies, without proving malicious package behavior.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: index.js discards interceptor settings during configuration normalization, making requested approval policies ineffective. interceptor.js then logs BLOCK results and warns on QUARANTINE results without preventing execution. Isolated checks confirmed both paths; successful downstream memory storage was not established.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Hooks and stored memories persist as expected. Bootstrap repair defaults on, recursively removes two named legacy hook directories without backups, and can overwrite three canonical hook files. This is explicitly disclosed, bounded and disableable, rather than evidence of hidden persistence.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: Persistent memory, security audits and optional cloud sync fit the disclosed purpose, consistent with the [publisher repository](https://github.com/Drakon-Systems-Ltd/ShieldCortex). Sensitive access alone does not establish misuse.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Do not rely on this bundled OpenClaw approval gate until configuration handling and enforcement are fixed. Prefer reviewed, pinned local dependencies. Back up existing hook directories or set SHIELDCORTEX_SKIP_SELF_HEAL=1 before startup. Review auto-memory settings and understand that enabling full cloud memory sync can upload saved content.
llm.findings:
[T09] unexpected: Confirmed that configuration normalization removes the operator's interception policy. Default handling also permits pipeline BLOCK/QUARANTINE results unless the independent inline guard rejects them. This contradicts the advertised approval control, but does not prove bypass of downstream storage protections.
[T09] expected: Confirmed automatic legacy-directory deletion and hook-file copying. The documentation accurately discloses the scope, missing deletion backups and opt-out controls, reducing this concern to a maintenance caution.
